raw_user_prompt: Build a single-command pipeline script at .agentic-pi/runtime/orchestrate_pipeline.py that spawns all QRSPI phases in sequence: 1) init run 2) compile goal contract 3) spawn planner-minimal agent 4) spawn guarded-worker agent 5) spawn verifier-generator agent 6) run formal verification 7) run cryptographic signing 8) run certify_run.py. The script uses subprocess to call existing harness tools. Must handle errors, verify files exist after each phase, and report final status.
